data.name: Hafsa
data.gender_notes: Hafsa is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-ف-ص (ḥ-f-ṣ); Ḥafṣa means 'young lioness'. Its root is ح-ف-ص (ḥ-f-ṣ). Borne by Ḥafṣa bint ʿUmar, wife of the Prophet ﷺ. Hafsa is a Arabic name meaning “Young lioness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hafsa expresses “Young lioness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-ف-ص (ḥ-f-ṣ); Ḥafṣa means 'young lioness'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafsa total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
